title: Cart subtotal does not reflect item quantity
description: When I increase the quantity of an item in my cart to 2 or more, the subtotal and total still show the price for a single unit.
steps_to_reproduce: Add Mechanical Keyboard ($120.00) to the cart.
Click the '+' button to increase quantity to 2.
Observe the Subtotal and Total in the cart panel.
actual: Subtotal stays at $120.00 regardless of quantity.

title: Product search fails on uppercase or mixed-case queries
description: Searching for a product using uppercase letters returns no results even though the product is in the catalog.
steps_to_reproduce: Type 'KEYBOARD' into the product search box.
expected: Mechanical Keyboard should appear in the product list.

title: Promo code discount is deducted twice from the cart total
description: Applying a valid promo code like SAVE10 reduces the final total by 20% instead of 10%, even though the discount line shows 10%.
steps_to_reproduce: Add Mechanical Keyboard ($120.00) to the cart.
expected: Discount should be -$12.00 and Total should be $108.00.

title: Searching for a nonexistent product crashes the page
description: When a search query matches zero products, the page crashes with a runtime error instead of showing an empty-state message.
expected: The page should display 'No products match your search.'
actual: The application throws a TypeError and fails to render.

title: Decreasing item quantity to zero does not remove it from the cart
description: Clicking '-' when an item has quantity 1 leaves the item stuck in the cart instead of removing it.
steps_to_reproduce: Add any product to the cart (quantity 1).
Click the '-' button next to the item.
expected: The item should be removed from the cart.
actual: The item remains in the cart with quantity 1.

title: Cart allows ordering above stock and ignores promo codes with extra spaces
description: Users can set item quantities higher than available stock, and pasting a promo code with leading or trailing spaces fails to apply the discount.
steps_to_reproduce: Add Wireless Mouse (stock: 15) and set its quantity above 15.
Enter ' SAVE10 ' with spaces into the promo code field.
expected: Quantity should be capped at available stock (15), and ' SAVE10 ' should apply the 10% discount.
actual: Quantity exceeds stock and the promo discount is $0.00.
